articles.title: Crypto PACs made big Republican push in final weeks before November 3 election
articles.snippet: Even as polling and online wagers put Democrats at a high chance to claim greater power in Congress, the industry's high-profile support has gone the other direction.

articles.title: Chrome Can Now Pull Details From Your Gmail to Fill Out Web Forms
articles.snippet: Chrome's new autofill uses Google's Gemini AI to search your Gmail for order numbers, tracking details, and flight bookings and fill them into web forms. It is rolling out in the U.S.

articles.title: Utah Files Felony Charges Against Kalshi, Co-Founders Over Sports Bets
articles.snippet: The state says an undercover agent placed a dozen sports wagers on Kalshi, a day after the CFTC sued Utah to block its enforcement actions.
